title: Explore runtime token-cleanup strategies (reduce reliance on a long-running cleartokens)
author: dopry
body_preview: ## Motivation  `cleartokens` is a management command that operators routinely **forget to schedule**, so expired token rows pile up (access/refresh/ID tokens, grants).
